Thank you for taking time to visit my channel. My name is Catherine & I love following my heart, animals, & striving to live a healthier lifestyle....although pizza 🍕 is still my favorite all time food. I’m also in continual pursuit of finding the best tasting mocha latte ☕️

I enjoy trying new recipes, tips, & kitchen tricks, riding horses, & spending time with my epileptic dog,  Frankie. I also started investing in 2017 and wish I would have listened to my Dad when I was in my 20s (don't we all - hahahaha). I lean on God during the hard times and enjoy his guidance and blessings in the good and bad times. 

Anyway, this is my journey and I am so happy you have decided to stop in to "see" what I am up to. Take care & God bless!!

** some posts contain affiliate links and I earn a small commission from them. Thank you for your support 😊
